'''Lost Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']], the [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|''Neutron Star''-class bulk cruiser]] [[Diligent (Neutron Star-class)|''Diligent'']] and the [[Assault Frigate Mark I]] [[Haven (Assault Frigate)|''Haven'']] were based at this station in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] was trained at Lost Station after he joined the Alliance.
